Features

Every kind of text becomes a video. Just describe what you want.

When Pexo serves as your text-to-video agent, it doesn't matter what you start with. A half-formed idea, a product spec, a script, or even a reference image is fine. It covers every layer of production and delivers a finished video in one conversation.

Idea to Visual

A scene in your head. Now a scene on screen.

You picture a golden-hour rooftop, a cat leaping across bookshelves, or a sci-fi cityscape at dawn. Describe it in plain language, even half-formed, vibes-only, and messy. Pexo turns text into a video that looks exactly how you imagined it. No storyboard. No editing timeline. Just describe and go.

Product Specs to Video

Turn a spec sheet into a product video that sells.

Paste your product parameters, drop in a PDF, or describe what's on the listing page. Pexo reads the details, generates a narrated product showcase with visuals, motion, and a voiceover. It functions as a text-to-video maker, turning dry specs into scroll-stopping demos.

Long-form to Short-form

Paste a blog post. Get a video summary ready to post.

Drop in a long article, a thread, or a URL's worth of content. Pexo extracts the core points, structures a visual narrative with voiceover, and delivers a short video you can publish on social. Try it now to get the fastest way to convert text to video from content you've already written.

Script to Scene

Already have a script? Pexo shoots it.

Paste a screenplay, a dialogue draft, or a story outline. Pexo breaks it into scenes, assigns visual direction, adds voiceover and transitions, and delivers a multi-scene video that holds together from first frame to last. It operates as a complete text-to-video creator — not just a clip generator.

Mood to B-Roll

Describe a feeling. Get footage that matches it.

Writing a music video, a brand reel, or an atmospheric intro? Describe the mood — "hazy neon Tokyo at 2 a.m." or "warm golden light through a greenhouse" — and Pexo generates B-Roll sequences you can cut straight into your edit. This is what separates Pexo from basic text-to-video tools.

Reference-based Creation

Start from what you already have.

Drop in a mood board, a product photo, a competitor's clip, or any visual reference. Add a text description of what you want. Pexo takes it from there, which actually matches your brand direction, not just a generic generator.

Common Questions About Text to Video

How detailed does my text description need to be?

As vague or specific as you like. Pexo reads your intent and asks follow-up questions if anything is unclear. You don't need prompt syntax or special formatting.

Is there a free text-to-video option?

Yes. You can start for free with no credit card required. Free text-to-video generation is available on the starter plan.

Can I control the style, length, and aspect ratio?

Yes. Specify style, duration, and aspect ratio in your description. Or leave it to Pexo to decide based on your content.

Does Pexo write the script too, or just generate visuals?

Both. Pexo generates the narrative structure, visual direction, and voice, and builds the full video from your text. Pexo functions as a complete text-to-video creator, not just a clip generator.

Which AI text-to-video models does Pexo use?

Pexo selects from multiple leading video AI models, including Seedance, Kling, and others, based on what best fits your content type and style.

Can I use Pexo as a text to video app on mobile?

Yes. Pexo works inside Telegram, WhatsApp, and Discord on any device. No separate text to video app needed.

How is this different from other text to video software?

Most text to video software requires prompt engineering and manual model selection. Pexo operates as a creative agent. It interprets your idea, makes production decisions, and delivers a finished video. It's not a tool you configure; it's a partner that thinks with you.

Can I use my own images or clips with text?

Yes. Drop in reference images or existing footage and describe what you want. Pexo uses your assets to guide the result.
